note: Build mode's land-shaping tools, shown in Land beside the ground paints. Each `sample` is a small ordinary area document (pipeline/AREAS.md) drawn for the tool's card and details picture; samples are never played. The rules live in core/area_build.gd.

tools.title: Raise land
tools.blurb: Lift the ground one level, to make a terrace with a cliff round it. Land goes up to level 2.
tools.spec:
Drag over ground to raise it
Cliffs block walking: add stairs

tools.title: Lower land
tools.blurb: Bring raised ground down a level. The valley floor is as low as land goes: dig water to go deeper.
tools.spec:
Drag over raised ground to lower it
One drag = one undo

tools.title: Stone stairs
tools.blurb: A flight of steps up a cliff one level high. Set it at the foot of the cliff; it climbs toward it.
tools.spec:
Click at the foot of a cliff
R picks the way when two cliffs meet
Delete tool takes stairs away

tools.title: Dig water
tools.blurb: Dig a pond or a stream at the ground's own level. Water that runs on to lower water falls as a waterfall.
tools.spec:
Drag over ground to flood it
Nobody walks on water

tools.title: Fill in
tools.blurb: Fill water in with earth and grass, at the level it lay. A bridge's crossing and the mill race stay wet.
tools.spec:
Drag over water to fill it
One drag = one undo
